dedupe_keys.name: geoportal mopc road network bridges and services map of the dominican republic

description: The GeoPortal of the Dominican Ministry of Public Works and Communications (MOPC) publishes official information on the country's road infrastructure in a web map. The entry page read on 2026-09-28 says the platform shows the state of roads, rural roads and bridges and the ministry's services across the country, with measurement and georeferencing tools, and summarises the road inventory as updated in September 2019: 1,395 km of trunk roads, 2,412 km of secondary roads, 1,620 km of tertiary roads, more than 60,000 km of rural roads, tracks and paths, and more than 2,600 hydraulic works including bridges, fords and culverts. Coverage is national. Access is free in the browser; no licence or download is stated. Caveats: the inventory figures date from 2019, and the map layers were not opened past the entry page. It supports road network models and hazard exposure of bridges and culverts to floods and hurricanes in the Dominican Republic. Related record: data-mopc-dominican-road-infrastructure-and-condition gives the ministry's maintenance table as open data.
